curves.blurb: Risky brawler: every missing heart hits harder, and one knockout is never the end.
Speed demon: chain Sets inside 5 seconds, then cash a max Combo in for double damage.
Gambler: guess boldly. Every mistake is ammo, and the first one each wave is free.
Sniper: wait for the perfect Set, then freeze the world with a Rainbow Strike.
Board shaper: fetches power and gold cards, then zooms the whole board clean.
Laid-back: free Sets, free glows. The board does half the work for you.

solo.name: Monochrome Pact
solo.upside: Sets with only 1 different trait deal +5 bonus damage.
solo.tradeoff: Rainbow Strikes deal 1× damage instead of 2×.

solo.name: Prismatic Fever
solo.upside: Rainbow Strikes deal 3× damage and restore +4s on timed fights.

solo.name: Controlled Burn
solo.upside: Every 12s, a wrong Set ignites 2 board cards instead of costing a heart.
solo.tradeoff: You start each fight with 0 Graces.

solo.name: Glass Prism
solo.upside: Power (+2 dmg) and Gold (+3¢) cards appear 4× as often.
solo.tradeoff: Your maximum Hearts are locked to 2.

solo.name: Overkill Harvest
solo.upside: Every point of overkill damage past 0 HP pays +2 coins; wave clears heal +1 Heart.
solo.tradeoff: Foes enter the arena with +15% HP.

solo.name: Scholar's Gambit
solo.upside: 2× XP gained and 4 weapon choices per level-up instead of 3.

solo.name: Catalyst Resonance
solo.upside: Catalysts appear twice as often, and every Evolution bursts for 8 damage + 8s.
solo.tradeoff: Foes enter the arena with +10% HP.

solo.name: Tempo Surge
solo.upside: Every valid Set deals +25% damage and refunds +2s on timed fights.
solo.tradeoff: Timed clocks tick 20% faster (or −1 move on move-limited fights, min 4).
